SELECT min((nullif((SELECT length(t2.variant) FROM routes AS t4 WHERE t1.c2 = t4.session LIMIT 1), (SELECT (t5.private_config / t1.c2) + nullif(t6.secondary_post, t1.c2) FROM buildings AS t5 LEFT JOIN trips AS t6 ON true WHERE (t1.c3 = t6.id) AND (gen_random_uuid() >= gen_random_uuid()) LIMIT 1))::numeric) - (t2.id::numeric)), string_agg(t2.variant, (SELECT t7.fabric FROM devices AS t7 INNER JOIN buildings AS t8 ON (t7.build::timestamptz) <> date_trunc('millennium'::text, t8.appointment::timestamptz) WHERE t7.transaction LIMIT 1))

FROM (clauses AS t1 INNER JOIN employees AS t2 ON (mod((SELECT t1.ticket FROM (SELECT current_date AS c1, 'lorem'::text AS c2, t7.pending_employee AS c3 FROM reports AS t6 LEFT JOIN votes AS t7 ON 0 <= t7.discount WHERE t6.processed_task) AS t4 INNER JOIN policies AS t5 ON EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legacy_services AS t8 LEFT JOIN reports AS t9 ON t9.city WHERE t9.archived_feature) WHERE (t2.channel = t5.premium_department) AND t2.scheduled_recipe LIMIT 1), t1.route)::numeric) >= (t1.ticket::numeric)) INNER JOIN policies AS t3 ON t1.id = t3.scheduled_metric
WHERE (SELECT date_trunc('quarter'::text, current_date::timestamptz) <= (current_date::timestamptz) FROM (SELECT t12.archived_reservation AS c1, t12.pending_lane AS c2 FROM releases AS t12 WHERE 10 < mod(t12.premium_contract, nullif(t12.custom_tag, t12.custom_tag)::int8)) AS t11 WHERE (SELECT current_date FROM releases AS t13 WHERE t11.c1 = t13.custom_tag LIMIT 1) <> current_date LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY t1.id DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT t2.scheduled_recipe, (SELECT t16.region FROM legacy_services AS t15 LEFT JOIN premium_accounts AS t16 ON (mod(t15.customer, t15.active_report)::float8) <= (t16.id::float8) LIMIT 1), bool_and(t2.scheduled_recipe) OVER ()
FROM ((SELECT t4.discount % (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_array_length('[]'::jsonb), 1000) FROM (reports AS t6 INNER JOIN releases AS t7 ON t6.id = t7.premium_contract) LEFT JOIN archived_lots AS t8 ON t6.id = t8.service LIMIT 1) AS c1, 2 AS c2, t4.variant AS c3 FROM votes AS t4 INNER JOIN policies AS t5 ON (t5.scheduled_metric::numeric) < t4.city) AS t1 LEFT JOIN employees AS t2 ON (t1.c1::int8) > (least(t1.c1, (SELECT t11.draft_subscription FROM (votes AS t9 INNER JOIN policies AS t10 ON true) INNER JOIN premium_accounts AS t11 ON t11.appointment WHERE t2.scheduled_recipe = t11.appointment LIMIT 1))::int8)) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (t12.discount::int8) + coalesce(t12.raw_alert, t1.c1) AS c1 FROM votes AS t12 INNER JOIN reports AS t13 ON 7 > (t12.id - (t12.id * t2.id)) WHERE (t1.c1 = t12.raw_alert) AND t12.filter) AS t3 ON EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countries AS t14 WHERE (t2.sku = '2024-01-01 12:00:00+00'::timestamptz) AND t14.bin)
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (reports AS t17 LEFT JOIN archived_lots AS t18 ON t17.id = t18.service) LEFT JOIN policies AS t19 ON (SELECT t22.bin FROM (legacy_services AS t20 INNER JOIN releases AS t21 ON current_date <= current_date) LEFT JOIN countries AS t22 ON t22.bin WHERE t22.bin LIMIT 1) WHERE (SELECT t17.city FROM legacy_services AS t23 INNER JOIN policies AS t24 ON false WHERE (t19.premium_department = t24.id) AND t17.raw_post LIMIT 1))

SELECT (SELECT t3.post || 'two'::text FROM (SELECT 7 / t14.active_container AS c1, t14.active_container AS c2, NULL::int4 AS c3 FROM countries AS t14) AS t13 WHERE (t2.raw_alert = 1) AND t2.reservation IN (SELECT current_date FROM releases AS t15 WHERE current_date >= current_date) LIMIT 1)
FROM (countries AS t1 INNER JOIN votes AS t2 ON t2.filter) INNER JOIN premium_accounts AS t3 ON t3.feature IN (SELECT (SELECT char_length(t4.legacy_branch) FROM policies AS t11 WHERE (t4.size = t11.id) AND ((t2.discount::int8) > (((t1.active_container::int8) % abs(t2.id)) % (length(t2.legacy_category ->> (t2.pending_employee::text))::int8))) LIMIT 1) FROM archived_lots AS t4 LEFT JOIN (SELECT (least(t6.customer, t6.active_report) + (nullif(t8.route, t8.route) / t6.active_report)) + jsonb_array_length('[1, 2, 3]'::jsonb) AS c1, t6.customer AS c2 FROM (legacy_services AS t6 INNER JOIN reports AS t7 ON t7.raw_post) INNER JOIN clauses AS t8 ON t8.bin >= (t7.release::timestamptz) WHERE t7.raw_post) AS t5 ON (SELECT false FROM legacy_services AS t9, archived_lots AS t10 WHERE true LIMIT 1) WHERE (t1.bin = false) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countries AS t12 WHERE (t2.private_host = t12.id) AND false))
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM votes AS t16 INNER JOIN reports AS t17 ON t16.filter WHERE t3.post = t17.verified_order)
ORDER BY (SELECT t3.post || 'two'::text FROM (SELECT 7 / t14.active_container AS c1, t14.active_container AS c2, NULL::int4 AS c3 FROM countries AS t14) AS t13 WHERE (t2.raw_alert = 1) AND t2.reservation IN (SELECT current_date FROM releases AS t15 WHERE current_date >= current_date) LIMIT 1) DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT true, avg(least(t1.id::numeric, t2.id::numeric) * greatest(t1.event, (SELECT 7 * (abs(t10.active_container) / (SELECT t11.discount FROM votes AS t11 LIMIT 1)) FROM countries AS t10 WHERE t10.bin LIMIT 1))) OVER (), least((SELECT (least(t12.public_lead, t2.active_report)::int8) + t12.id FROM archived_lots AS t12 INNER JOIN policies AS t13 ON (SELECT true FROM reports AS t14, employees AS t15 WHERE (t12.keyword = 100) AND t14.archived_feature LIMIT 1) = t13.historical_ticket WHERE t2.active_report = t12.keyword LIMIT 1), ((t2.active_report % (SELECT (SELECT t1.service FROM archived_lots AS t21 INNER JOIN premium_accounts AS t22 ON t21.keyword <> t17.customer WHERE (t1.ticket = t21.ticket) AND t22.appointment LIMIT 1) FROM (SELECT least(3 - t19.discount, t18.customer) AS c1, t18.active_report AS c2, t19.variant AS c3 FROM legacy_services AS t18 INNER JOIN votes AS t19 ON false) AS t16 LEFT JOIN legacy_services AS t17 ON (SELECT false <= ((false < ((t20.pending_lane::float8) < (t20.historical_bin::float8))) < ((t20.release::int8) = t20.id)) FROM releases AS t20 WHERE true LIMIT 1) WHERE (t1.ticket = 0.0) AND t1.keyword IN (SELECT 42 + (mod(0, char_length('quux'::text) / t25.archived_reservation)::int8) FROM (archived_lots AS t23 INNER JOIN employees AS t24 ON t24.scheduled_recipe) LEFT JOIN releases AS t25 ON t24.scheduled_recipe WHERE t1.event = t23.event) LIMIT 1))::numeric) + (SELECT mod(t26.c1, t1.keyword % t1.service) FROM (SELECT t28.discount AS c1, t28.variant AS c2 FROM votes AS t28) AS t26 INNER JOIN votes AS t27 ON EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees AS t29, premium_accounts AS t30, archived_lots AS t31 WHERE t30.appointment) WHERE t1.raw_package = t27.reservation LIMIT 1))
FROM archived_lots AS t1 INNER JOIN legacy_services AS t2 ON (SELECT gen_random_uuid() FROM reports AS t3 LEFT JOIN countries AS t4 ON (SELECT current_date FROM (releases AS t5 LEFT JOIN premium_accounts AS t6 ON t3.verified_order < (t6.rule ->> t2.active_product)) INNER JOIN clauses AS t7 ON t5.pending_lane = t7.id WHERE (t1.service = t5.custom_tag) AND t3.raw_post LIMIT 1) > current_date WHERE (t2.active_product = t3.verified_order) AND (t4.active_container <= (((length(t3.verified_order) % t1.public_lead) * (100 / (SELECT t9.draft_subscription FROM clauses AS t8 INNER JOIN premium_accounts AS t9 ON t8.build WHERE t8.build LIMIT 1))) + t2.customer)) LIMIT 1) = gen_random_uuid()
ORDER BY least((SELECT (least(t12.public_lead, t2.active_report)::int8) + t12.id FROM archived_lots AS t12 INNER JOIN policies AS t13 ON (SELECT true FROM reports AS t14, employees AS t15 WHERE (t12.keyword = 100) AND t14.archived_feature LIMIT 1) = t13.historical_ticket WHERE t2.active_report = t12.keyword LIMIT 1), ((t2.active_report % (SELECT (SELECT t1.service FROM archived_lots AS t21 INNER JOIN premium_accounts AS t22 ON t21.keyword <> t17.customer WHERE (t1.ticket = t21.ticket) AND t22.appointment LIMIT 1) FROM (SELECT least(3 - t19.discount, t18.customer) AS c1, t18.active_report AS c2, t19.variant AS c3 FROM legacy_services AS t18 INNER JOIN votes AS t19 ON false) AS t16 LEFT JOIN legacy_services AS t17 ON (SELECT false <= ((false < ((t20.pending_lane::float8) < (t20.historical_bin::float8))) < ((t20.release::int8) = t20.id)) FROM releases AS t20 WHERE true LIMIT 1) WHERE (t1.ticket = 0.0) AND t1.keyword IN (SELECT 42 + (mod(0, char_length('quux'::text) / t25.archived_reservation)::int8) FROM (archived_lots AS t23 INNER JOIN employees AS t24 ON t24.scheduled_recipe) LEFT JOIN releases AS t25 ON t24.scheduled_recipe WHERE t1.event = t23.event) LIMIT 1))::numeric) + (SELECT mod(t26.c1, t1.keyword % t1.service) FROM (SELECT t28.discount AS c1, t28.variant AS c2 FROM votes AS t28) AS t26 INNER JOIN votes AS t27 ON EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees AS t29, premium_accounts AS t30, archived_lots AS t31 WHERE t30.appointment) WHERE t1.raw_package = t27.reservation LIMIT 1)) ASC
